_format: Approach cards (the verbs the protagonist uses). Each: name, cost (pages), category? (the matching ward), tags (classes this approach 'handles'), kind (handler dispatch), params (kind-specific), desc, voice. Handler kinds resolved in src/approaches.js. The patient's intent has counteredBy listing approach keys; playing a listed key handles it and earns Insight.

listen.name: Listen
listen.desc: If their intent is speech, gain +1 Insight when they resolve.
listen.voice: I hold the pen still. I let them say it.

note.name: Note
note.desc: Reveal a hidden file fragment. +1 Insight first time per intake.
note.voice: I write what is here. The page accepts it.

press.name: Press
press.desc: Delay their intent one turn. They lash next, but speech finishes.
press.voice: I do not let the silence answer for them.

step_back.name: Step back
step_back.desc: -2 Composure damage this turn. Adds nothing else.
step_back.voice: I move the chair back. The desk is still between us.

wait.name: Wait
wait.desc: End your turn. +1 Insight if they are Witness-class.
wait.voice: I sit. The room does what it does.

ask.name: Ask
ask.desc: If Mourner: +3 Insight and reveal a fragment. Otherwise: -2 Composure (they bristle).
ask.voice: I ask who they were waiting for.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.desc: If Visitor: +3 Insight and reveal a fragment. Otherwise: -2 Composure (they reject the mirror).
reflect.voice: I do what they did. The room ~~learns~~ remembers.

hold.name: Hold
hold.desc: Block one physical intent. If Tenant: +3 Insight and reveal a fragment.
hold.voice: I keep my hand on the wrist. The wrist remembers.

witness.name: Witness
witness.desc: Sit with them. If Witness: +3 Insight and reveal a fragment. Otherwise: +1 Composure.
witness.voice: I do not look at the corner. I look at them.

match.name: Match
match.desc: Reveal their category. If Stranger: +3 Insight.
match.voice: I find the rhythm. I keep ~~time~~ pace with it.

tell.name: Tell
tell.desc: Read your own file to them. Reveal a fragment of yours. +2 Insight if they answer.
tell.voice: I read them !!my!! page. They listen as if it were theirs.

restrain.name: Restrain
restrain.voice: I move quickly. They do not resist as much as they should.

sedate.name: Sedate
sedate.desc: Patient skips their next 2 intents. -1 Insight (they reveal nothing while quiet).
sedate.voice: The dose is small. !!Smaller than I am used to.!!

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.desc: Copy their last intent back. If they had no last, they take their next turn now.
mirror.voice: I do what they did. They do not know how to receive it.

pry.name: Pry
pry.desc: Reveal 2 fragments. They lash next regardless.
pry.voice: I read between the lines. The page tears a little.

linger.name: Linger
linger.desc: +2 Pages next turn. End your turn.
linger.voice: I stay. The minute hand does the work.

mark.name: Mark
mark.desc: Write their name in the wrong place. +2 Insight, -1 Composure.
mark.voice: I sign their file with !!a name I do not know is theirs.!!

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.desc: Suspend one of your scars for this intake.
cleanse.voice: I wash my hands. The water is the room's.

lean_in.name: Lean in
lean_in.desc: Take their next intent at full damage. +4 Insight regardless of category.
lean_in.voice: I let them. I take it. !!I write it down.!!

refuse.name: Refuse
refuse.desc: Skip their next intent entirely. -1 Insight.
refuse.voice: I close the file early. The room ~~objects~~ adjusts.

document.name: Document
document.desc: Reveal a fragment. If you already revealed all, +1 Insight.
document.voice: I write down what is observed. The pen moves first.

diagnose.name: Diagnose
diagnose.desc: Name their ward. Right → +3 Insight. Wrong → -4 Composure.
diagnose.voice: I write the ward across the top of the page. !!In ink.!!

name_them.name: Name them
name_them.desc: Only when Insight is full. End the intake. File the patient.
name_them.voice: I close the file. The page is theirs now.
